title: Tailwise Pharmacy Class Schedule: Veterinary Authorization and Validity Terms
content:
Tailwise Pharmacy fills a prescription only on a veterinarian's authorization. This schedule sets, for each of the six Tailwise Pharmacy classes, how the authorization request is sent and followed up, how many refills one authorization may carry, and how long an authorized prescription can be filled.

## Schedule

| Class | Channels for authorization requests | First request sent within | Wait after each attempt | Attempts in total | Largest refills recorded on one authorization | Validity from authorization date | Denied prescription resubmitted only as a new order after the customer speaks to the veterinarian |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | e-authorization, fax, phone | 1 business day | 3 business days | 3 | 11 | 12 calendar months | Yes |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | e-authorization, fax, phone | 1 business day | 3 business days | 3 | 11 | 12 calendar months | Yes |
| Rx Prescription Diet | e-authorization, fax, phone | 1 business day | 3 business days | 3 | 23 | 12 calendar months | Yes |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | e-authorization, fax, phone | 1 business day | 2 business days | 3 | 3 | 6 calendar months | Yes |
| Rx Controlled Substance | e-authorization, phone | 1 business day | 2 business days | 3 | 5 | 6 calendar months | Yes |
| Rx Compounded Medication | e-authorization, fax, phone | 1 business day | 3 business days | 2 | 5 | 6 calendar months | Yes |

## Column definitions

- **Channels for authorization requests**: the channels the pharmacy may use to request the veterinarian's authorization. Rx Controlled Substance requests are never sent by fax.
- **First request sent within**: business days after the order within which the pharmacy sends the first authorization request.
- **Wait after each attempt**: business days the pharmacy waits for the veterinarian after each authorization attempt.
- **Attempts in total**: authorization attempts made in total before an unanswered request closes as no response.
- **Largest refills recorded on one authorization**: refills are the fills after the first fill; the pharmacy never records more refills than this on one authorization, so the fills authorized are at most this figure plus the first fill.
- **Validity from authorization date**: calendar months from the authorization date after which the prescription can no longer be filled, unless the veterinarian wrote an earlier expiry.
- **Resubmission column**: whether a denied prescription can only be resubmitted as a new order naming the veterinarian again.

## Reading the schedule (illustrations)

- An Rx Prescription Diet authorization can carry at most 23 refills, that is 24 fills in total counting the first fill; an Rx Short-Course Medication authorization at most 3 refills, 4 fills in total.
- An Rx Compounded Medication request closes as no response after 2 unanswered attempts; every other class allows 3 attempts.
- Hypothetical example: a veterinarian writes 30 refills on an Rx Maintenance Medication prescription. The pharmacy records 11 refills, so 12 fills are authorized.
